task_list.name: Threshold Segmentation
task_list.docs_info:
### Purpose
- Segment cells darker than the background using Gaussian smoothing, automatic (Yen) thresholding, hole filling & size filtering.

### Outputs
- A label image

mode.description: The mode to use for channel selection. Can be "label", "wavelength_id", or "index".
mode.title: Mode

identifier.description:
The identifier for the channel selection. The interpretation of this field depends
on the mode:
- If mode is "label", this should be the channel label.
- If mode is "wavelength_id", this should be the wavelength ID of the channel.
- If mode is "index", this should be the index of the channel (must be an integer).
identifier.title: Identifier

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Select the input channel to be used for segmentation. Defaults to the "LightLoss_Imaging" channel.

label_name.title: Label Name
label_name.description: Name of the resulting label image. If not provided, it will be set to "<channel_identifier>_thresholded".

sigma.title: Sigma
sigma.description: Standard deviation of the Gaussian smoothing along (y, x).

max_size.title: Max Size
max_size.description: Objects with this many pixels or fewer are removed.

overwrite.title: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite an existing label image. Defaults to True.

task_list.name: FCF S8 Converter
task_list.docs_info:
### Purpose
- Convert data from S8 Flow Cytometer (TIFF files) to OME-Zarr format.
- Optionally store the event data of the matching FCS file as a feature table.

### Outputs
- A single mosaic OME-Zarr file containing all converted images. Optionally in plate format
- If an FCS file is provided, an "fcs_events" feature table with the raw values of all
  events, indexed by "event_index" (matching the FOV ROI names).

### Limitations
- POC implementation, only tested on a single dataset
- FCS values are stored as float32, integer parameters need to be reinterpreted

zarr_dir.title: Zarr Dir
zarr_dir.description: path of the directory where the new OME-Zarrs will be created. (standard argument for Fractal tasks, managed by Fractal server).

tiff_folder_path.title: Tiff Folder Path
tiff_folder_path.description: Path to the folder containing the TIFF files of the S8 FACS to be converted.

fcs_file_path.title: Fcs File Path
fcs_file_path.description: Path to the FCS file of the same recording. If provided, all its events are saved as the "fcs_events" feature table, with the raw values of all parameters and an "event_index" column matching the names of the ROIs in "FOV_ROI_table". Values are stored as float32, so integer parameters show up as meaningless floats until reinterpreted (e.g. with `.view(np.uint32)`).

zarr_name.title: Zarr Name
zarr_name.description: Name of the output OME-Zarr, without the ".ome.zarr" extension. Used for the plate if `fake_a_plate` is True, otherwise for the image. If None, the name of the TIFF folder is used, with special characters (e.g. whitespace, "#", parentheses) replaced by underscores.

fake_a_plate.title: Fake A Plate
fake_a_plate.description: Whether to create a fake plate structure with a single well "A01" containing the mosaic image. This is useful to use some tools that need plates (e.g. Fractal feature explorer). Defaults to True.

add_z_singleton.title: Add Z Singleton
add_z_singleton.description: Whether to add a singleton Z dimension to the OME-Zarr. This is useful to use some of the tools (like the Fractal feature explorer) that require Z singleton dimensions. Defaults to False.

convert_first_x_tiffs.title: Convert First X Tiffs
convert_first_x_tiffs.description: If provided, only the first X TIFF files in the folder are converted. This is useful for testing with a smaller number of files. If None, all TIFF files in the folder are converted.

overwrite.title: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite an existing OME-Zarr image (and fake plate, if `fake_a_plate` is True). Defaults to True.

task_list.name: Region Props Features
task_list.docs_info:
### Purpose
- Makes region properties measurements on label images and stores them in the OME-Zarr format.

### Outputs
- A measurements table in the OME-Zarr format.

label_image_name.title: Label Image Name
label_image_name.description: Name of the label image to analyze.

output_table_name.title: Output Table Name
output_table_name.description: Name for the output feature table.

refercene_roi_table.title: Refercene Roi Table
refercene_roi_table.description: Optional ROI table for reference. If provided, it is measured which ROI from this table every object centroid is in.

overwrite.title: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite an existing feature table. Defaults to True.
